zh.headline: Anthropic Fable 5 全球恢复访问
zh.observation: 今天最值得关注的信号是 **Anthropic 的"多线出击"战略**：Fable 5 解禁、Sonnet 5 发布、Claude Science 推出，三件大事同日发生，表明 Anthropic 正在 IPO 前夕全力展示产品矩阵的完整性和商业能力。同时，Sonnet 5 的"隐藏涨价"模式和 Claude Code 的监控风波也揭示了 AI 企业在商业化扩张中的隐忧——成本透明度和用户信任正在成为新的竞争维度。另外，Meta 和 SpaceX 纷纷将过剩算力货币化，预示着 AI 基础设施将从"自用"走向"开放市场"，这可能重塑云计算格局。

en.headline: Anthropic Restores Global Access to Claude Fable 5 After US Lifts Export Controls
en.observation: The strongest signal today is **AI model export controls becoming a new geopolitical bargaining chip** — Anthropic's Fable 5 was banned for two weeks then suddenly unbanned, exposing extreme uncertainty in US AI policy. Meanwhile, **both Meta and SpaceX are monetizing spare compute**, with Meta formally entering the cloud market, marking the arrival of the "AI compute as asset" era. On the open-source front, **AI agent toolchains are rapidly maturing** — from penetration testing (strix, VulnClaw) to video editing (video-use), from trading assistants (Vibe-Trading) to terminal management (herdr), agent deployment scenarios are expanding at breakneck speed. Finally, the **Claude Code hidden code incident** reminds the entire industry: open-source transparency in AI tools is not just a technical issue — it's a trust issue.

items.title: Anthropic Fable 5 Export Control Lift Sparks AI Geopolitics Debate
items.desc: The US Commerce Department abruptly lifted restrictions two weeks after issuing emergency export controls, with Anthropic restoring global access. Wired reports Anthropic added new safety measures to regain government favor. Community discussion centers on: the US government's erratic AI policy leaves the entire industry without certainty, and "safety" is becoming a bargaining chip rather than a principle for model releases.

items.title: r/LocalLLaMA Hot Topic: The Gap Between Closed and Open Models May Be Much Smaller Than Commonly Assumed
items.desc: — A user points out benchmarks compare "Claude the product" rather than "Claude model inference," with Anthropic doing extensive backend processing (hidden reasoning traces, post-processing) while open models run bare inference. This view gains widespread agreement, prompting a re-examination of benchmark fairness.
